'''June 2000 Terre Haute tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Terre Haute, IN on 24 June 2000. [[Matthew Wright]] won it. It is known from Matthew Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d935">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ terre-haute-in-6-24-00], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Terre Haute, IN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Wright]]
